text: Program Description Prpgram Discription This course is ideal for anyone wishing to advance their knowledge, skills, ability and career prospects in business. It enables you to convert your business-related foundation degree, HND or degree credits into an honours degree in business management. Degree Duration: 4 Years (3 without foundation) Core Modules Include: Strategic Planning, Organisational Behaviour, Marketing in a Global Context, Leadership in Contemporary Organisations and Implementing Strategy and Change. Who is it For? BA (Hons) Business Management is a broad subject incorporating business, economics, finance and marketing amongst other relevant disciplines. A Business Management degree is suitable if you wish to explore several career paths as it develops a student’s knowledge relevant to a diverse range of sectors. What’s included in the course? During the three years you will study a broad range of subjects, marketing in a global context, managing innovation and creativity, Global Governance in International Business, International Strategy, Developing People and Organisations, Managing for Success and Sustainable and Responsible business in the 21st century. What are the benefits of the course? This degree is awarded by Sheffield Hallam University, one of the U.K.’s most popular universities with over 30,000 students. Undergraduate degrees from Sheffield Hallam are well respected, with 70 percent of business graduates finding employment in a professional or managerial position within 6 months of graduation. What are my options after graduating? Some students proceed to Master studies while others gain employment in all types of sectors and organisations. After graduation, students are extremely well-positioned in the job market given that they hold a highly-regarded and internationally recognised degree from a respected U.K. university, but they also have international experience and language skills that enable them to stand out amongst peers. After graduation, you will have the experience and skills to analyse a commercial opportunity, manage a project, solve problems, be able to operate in different cultures, communicate with other people and ultimately lead them. Core Modules Include: Meeting,Conference and Exhibition Management,Stadium and Arena Management,Creativity and Innovation in Context and Global Events and Festivals.
